dossiers.label: The myth of Prometheus and Epimetheus
dossiers.about: Protagoras' 'great speech': Epimetheus hands out all the powers to the beasts and leaves man naked; Prometheus steals fire and the crafts from Hephaestus and Athena; but men lack the political art until Zeus sends Hermes with shame and justice, to be given to all.

passage.end_quote: Πρωταγόρας μὲν τοσαῦτα καὶ τοιαῦτα ἐπιδειξάμενος ἀπεπαύσατο τοῦ λόγου

parts.label: A myth, or a reasoned account?
parts.quote: μῦθον λέγων ἐπιδείξω ἢ λόγῳ διεξελθών

parts.label: Man left naked and unshod
parts.quote: τὸν δὲ ἄνθρωπον γυμνόν τε καὶ ἀνυπόδητον καὶ ἄστρωτον καὶ ἄοπλον

parts.label: Prometheus steals fire and the crafts
parts.quote: κλέπτει Ἡφαίστου καὶ Ἀθηνᾶς τὴν ἔντεχνον σοφίαν σὺν πυρί

parts.label: Hermes brings shame and justice
parts.quote: Ἑρμῆν πέμπει ἄγοντα εἰς ἀνθρώπους αἰδῶ τε καὶ δίκην

parts.label: To all, and let all share
parts.quote: ἐπὶ πάντας, ἔφη ὁ Ζεύς, καὶ πάντες μετεχόντων

echoes.why: The Statesman's myth also has the gifts of Prometheus and Hephaestus.
At the end Socrates prefers Prometheus to Epimetheus as his guide.

related.why: The Statesman's myth gives fire and crafts to men too.

web.title: Protagoras (dialogue)
web.quote: they assigned two Titan brothers, Epimetheus ("afterthought") and Prometheus ("forethought")

dossiers.label: The measuring art
dossiers.about: Being 'overcome by pleasure' is a mistake of measurement: near pleasures look larger, as near objects do. What would save our lives is a measuring art that removes the power of appearance and lets the soul rest in the truth; so it is knowledge.

passage.start_quote: φαίνεται ὑμῖν τῇ ὄψει τὰ αὐτὰ μεγέθη ἐγγύθεν μὲν μείζω

parts.label: The measuring art or the power of appearance?
parts.quote: ἆρα ἡ μετρητικὴ τέχνη ἢ ἡ τοῦ φαινομένου δύναμις

parts.label: Appearance made us wander up and down
parts.quote: αὕτη μὲν ἡμᾶς ἐπλάνα καὶ ἐποίει ἄνω τε καὶ κάτω

parts.label: Measurement is an art and knowledge
parts.quote: ἐπεὶ δὲ μετρητική, ἀνάγκῃ δήπου τέχνη καὶ ἐπιστήμη

echoes.why: The Republic: measuring, counting and weighing rescue us from the appearances of painting.
